baseline_models.focus_anchor: The directed construction `يَرْمُونَ ٱلْمُحْصَنَاتِ` joins ر م ي to ح ص ن.
baseline_models.mechanism: The accusation behaves as a launched verbal object: it leaves a speaker and attempts to cross the enclosure around a guarded reputation.

activation_trace.role: Verbal casting supplies both the harmful speech and its outward vector.
Preservation inside a surrounding fort supplies the boundary that the speech attempts to breach.

changed_reading.before: The verse condemns an accusation against chaste women.
changed_reading.after: The accusation is a verbal projectile aimed across a protected boundary, so launching and carrying it are themselves invasive acts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The target sequence `ٱلْمُحْصَنَاتِ ٱلْغَافِلَاتِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ` follows the verb of casting.
baseline_models.mechanism: The accuser projects an unverified judgment into an absence: the women are outside alert participation in the allegation, while their security and credibility contrast with the speaker's misplaced conjecture.

activation_trace.role: A conjecture that misses supplies the accusation's epistemic failure.
Being outside present vigilance supplies the target's nonparticipation in the alleged scene.
Security and trust supply the credibility relation violated by the accusation.

changed_reading.before: The three adjectives merely inventory the victims' virtues.
changed_reading.after: They stage an epistemic asymmetry: trusting women stand outside the allegation while accusers fill that absence with a judgment that has missed its mark.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The outward `يَرْمُونَ` is followed by passive `لُعِنُوا` and the paired horizons `فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْآخِرَةِ`.
baseline_models.mechanism: The direction reverses. Speakers try to displace protected women by verbal casting, but the stated result displaces the speakers from good across both the near and later horizons and attaches severe pain to them.

activation_trace.role: The accusation supplies the initial outward motion.
Expulsion under displeasure reverses displacement onto the speakers.
The near or present world supplies the first temporal horizon.
What comes after supplies the second horizon.
Painful punishment makes the reversed consequence concrete.

changed_reading.before: The verse adds a general curse and future punishment to the offense.
changed_reading.after: The attempted reputational expulsion rebounds: the throwers, not the women, are displaced, and the reversal already spans present and later existence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The projectile model acquires an admissibility gate. A sexual accusation does not become accepted public knowledge merely by being launched; it must arrive with four present, knowledgeable witnesses, otherwise liar-status and sanctions rebound onto its source.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies the verbal claim that seeks public uptake.
The explicit four supplies the numerical threshold for the claim.
Presence with direct observation supplies the evidence the launched speech lacks.
Acceptance by consent supplies the institutional gate that closes after evidentiary failure.
Contrariety to truth supplies the status assigned when the witnesses do not arrive.

structural_cues: 24:4 repeats the focus construction of throwing at protected women, then sequences four witnesses before corporal and testimonial sanctions.
24:13 repeats the four-witness failure and assigns liar-status.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: repeated accusation, four witnesses, nonacceptance, and liar-status. Reader: I treat these as a gate that makes unsupported speech rebound rather than attach to its target. Alternative: 24:23 may announce a broader moral judgment without restating the legal gate.

changed_reading.before: The accusation is harmful because its content is false.
changed_reading.after: It is also procedurally inert against the women and self-incriminating against its source unless it crosses the four-witness evidence gate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The marital oath sequence turns accusation into self-binding testimony: repeated attestations culminate in the accuser placing the curse upon himself if he lies. The focus's passive plural curse can therefore echo a procedural condition that false accusers have already invoked against themselves.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge-bearing declaration supplies the repeated self-binding speech.
Mutual imprecation supplies the legal form in which an accuser directs a curse onto himself conditionally.
Contrariety to truth supplies the condition that activates the self-curse.
The focus states the resulting expulsion in passive plural form.

structural_cues: 24:6-9 sequences four attestations, a fifth imprecation, and counter-testimony before 24:23 states that the throwers have been cursed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: accusation becomes repeated testimony capped by conditional self-imprecation. Reader: I hear the later passive curse as a generalized rebound of that self-binding mechanism. Alternative: the repeated root may evoke expulsion broadly rather than carry the procedure directly into 24:23.

changed_reading.before: The curse is an externally appended penalty.
changed_reading.after: The curse can be heard as the matured consequence of speech that binds its own speaker: a false accuser has made himself the destination of the imprecation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rumor is a relay rather than one utterance. A mutually supporting group originates or sustains it, tongues receive and hand it onward, and diffusion enlarges its range; each handoff renews the focus's casting motion.

activation_trace.role: Motion between endpoints until arrival supplies the transferable trajectory of the allegation.
A surrounding, mutually supporting group supplies the social carrier.
Receiving and transmitting speech supplies the relay operation.
The speech organ supplies the bodily instrument for each handoff.
Diffusion and spreading supply the network-scale result.

structural_cues: 24:11 names a group, 24:15 describes tongue-to-tongue reception and speech without knowledge, and 24:19 names desired diffusion among believers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: group support, verbal reception, tongues, and spreading. Reader: I treat every knowing retransmission as a fresh throw. Alternative: `يَرْمُونَ` may name only originators while relayers remain culpable under the surrounding verses by a different description.

changed_reading.before: The plural throwers are several independent originators.
changed_reading.after: They can include a distributed relay whose listeners become launch points, making circulation rather than authorship alone the operative offense.

context_deltas.mechanism: Believing hearers are directed to place a good judgment into the informational gap and to treat the accused as their own selves. The focus's `غافلات مؤمنات` therefore marks both innocent nonparticipation and a communal trust claim.

activation_trace.role: Absence from vigilance supplies the informational gap without making the target culpable.
Trust and security supply the relation the community should preserve.
Judgment stabilized by an indication supplies the commanded favorable presumption.
The self or very person supplies the community's identification with the accused.
Inclination toward beneficial good supplies the content that should fill uncertainty.

structural_cues: 24:12 coordinates believing men and women as thinking good `of themselves` immediately upon hearing the report.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: hearers, good judgment, believers of both genders, and `their selves`. Reader: I read the self-language as communal identification that reverses suspicion into solidarity. Alternative: the phrase may be distributive, but it still directs favorable judgment toward fellow believers.

changed_reading.before: `Believing women` identifies a protected religious class and `heedless` describes a private state.
changed_reading.after: Together they make a public claim on hearers: the women's innocent absence must be met with the trust one extends to one's own communal self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's final `عظيم` answers a prior act of bad measurement. Speakers count ungrounded talk as light and easy, while the divine scale registers it as great; the great punishment mirrors the magnitude they failed to perceive.

activation_trace.role: Conjectural reckoning supplies the speakers' faulty scale.
Ease and lightness supply the minimizing valuation.
Greatness and force supply the countervaluation.
The repeated greatness attaches the corrected scale to the punishment.

structural_cues: 24:15 directly opposes `you count it light` to `it is great`, and 24:23 closes with the same greatness adjective.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: explicit light/great opposition followed by repeated `great` in the focus. Reader: I treat the punishment's scale as a correction of the speakers' moral mismeasurement. Alternative: the repeated adjective may intensify independently without a designed lexical answer.

changed_reading.after: It also corrects a corrupted social metric: what passes effortlessly from mouth to mouth has been radically undercounted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to erase the offense, turn away beautifully, and desire divine covering immediately precedes the passive curse. This separates divine judgment on slander from a human license to perpetuate social expulsion.

activation_trace.role: Leaving punishment and effacing the offense supplies the community's commanded posture.
Beautifully turning aside from fault supplies nonretaliatory disengagement.
Covering the offense and protecting its bearer from its effect supplies the desired divine mercy.
Expulsion under displeasure supplies the judgment that humans are not told to imitate indefinitely.

structural_cues: 24:22 immediately commands pardon and asks whether hearers desire divine forgiveness; 24:23 then states the curse in the passive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: horizontal pardon commands, desired divine forgiveness, then passive curse. Reader: I distinguish the community's merciful duty from the judgment announced over the offense. Alternative: the two ayat may address different offender sets, but their adjacency still resists appropriating the curse as personal vengeance.

changed_reading.before: Calling the accusers cursed could authorize believers to maintain their exclusion.
changed_reading.after: The curse names divine consequence while the immediately stated human posture remains pardon and restraint; judgment and social vengeance are not interchangeable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The organ that relayed the accusation becomes a witness against its owner, and the account is paid in full as reality is made manifest. The target need not defeat speech with more speech; the accuser carries the counter-evidence in his own body.

activation_trace.role: Verbal casting supplies the deed whose source later testifies.
The witnessing tongue supplies the reversal from instrument of accusation to instrument of evidence.
The bodily speech organ fixes the testimony to the speaker.
Full completion without deficiency supplies exact recompense.
Establishing and disclosing reality supplies the final defeat of the false claim.

structural_cues: 24:24 follows the focus immediately with tongues, hands, and feet testifying about deeds; 24:25 follows with full payment and manifest truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: bodily testimony, completed payment, and manifested truth directly after the focus. Reader: I make the outward accusation return as evidence stored at its bodily source. Alternative: the organs testify to all deeds, not slander alone, though adjacency makes this deed a salient instance.

changed_reading.before: The women require external witnesses or verbal defense to clear themselves.
changed_reading.after: The accusers' own speech organs become counter-witnesses, so the attempted accusation contains the material of its eventual refutation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated sorting of bad from good culminates in separation from what is said. Accusatory speech does not transfer its impurity to the protected women; it is screened off, exposing the quality of the discourse instead of contaminating its target.

activation_trace.role: The surrounding safeguard supplies the focus anchor for nonpenetration.
Dross expelled from material supplies the bad element to be sorted away.
Purification from bad material supplies the counter-class.
Acquittal as separation and distance prevents the saying from adhering to its target.

structural_cues: 24:26 repeats bad and good in gendered pairs, then declares a group separated from what others say.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: polarized qualities followed by acquittal from sayings. Reader: I model acquittal as a semantic quarantine in which uttered impurity cannot migrate into the target's identity. Alternative: the pairings may classify persons or speech differently, but the explicit separation from sayings still blocks attachment.

changed_reading.before: The women's fortification can be damaged by an accusation even if the charge is later rejected.
changed_reading.after: The surrounding sequence imagines a sorting boundary: false speech remains attributable to its own quality and is separated from the women it tried to define.

context_deltas.mechanism: The house-entry rules spatialize the fortification root. A person's protected reputation has a threshold: entering an interior without permission and refusing to turn back parallels speech that trespasses into intimate status without evidence.

activation_trace.role: An enclosing safeguard supplies the reputational interior.
Passage into an inside supplies the act regulated at the boundary.
Dwelling and shelter supply the concrete protected interior.
Permission supplies the gate whose absence requires withdrawal.

structural_cues: 24:27 forbids entering others' houses before seeking welcome and greeting; 24:28 requires return when entry is not permitted.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: protected interiors, entry, permission, and mandatory return. Reader: I map that spatial protocol onto the focus's fortified reputation. Alternative: the house rules may remain a separate privacy domain, so this is an analogy rather than a direct lexical gloss.

changed_reading.after: It also resembles unauthorized entry into a protected interior: the speaker claims access to intimate knowledge without crossing the required threshold.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later, women explicitly will self-fortification while others try to coerce them out of it. That sequence makes `المحصنات` an agential orientation, not only a status assigned by observers; accusation repeats coercion by overriding the women's own declared relation to themselves.

activation_trace.role: Guarded sexual integrity supplies the focus's protected orientation.
Forcing another into what she rejects supplies the opposing pressure.
Will and intention supply the women's own agency.
Desired sexual self-protection supplies an enacted counterpart to the focus participle.

structural_cues: 24:33 grammatically assigns the desire for fortification to the women and coercive force to those seeking gain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: women's will toward fortification opposed by others' coercion. Reader: I carry that agency into the focus participle and treat false naming as another override of self-directed integrity. Alternative: `المحصنات` in 24:23 may primarily denote an established status rather than a present act of will.

changed_reading.before: Protected women are passive bearers of a status that others recognize or police.
changed_reading.after: Their fortification includes their own chosen orientation; the accusation is violent partly because it replaces that agency with a label imposed from outside.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later promise joins believers to the replacement of fear by security. Accusing protected believing women therefore attacks more than private honor: it corrodes the social condition of trust and safety promised to the believing community.

activation_trace.role: Security and trust supply the focus's communal infrastructure.
One condition taking another's place supplies the promised conversion.
Expected harm supplies the social condition to be displaced.
The shared root joins believing subjects to security as the replacement state.

structural_cues: 24:55 places believing and security under one root and explicitly promises that fear will be replaced by security.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: believers, fear, substitution, and security. Reader: I infer that slander against believing women damages the shared safety the surah seeks to install. Alternative: the focus's `مؤمنات` may foreground doctrinal belief while the later noun foregrounds civil security.

changed_reading.after: It also sabotages communal security by making even protected believers vulnerable to unverified public naming.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the opening title need not activate a wall image in ordinary reading. It remains anchored through the packet's surrounding-wall branch for س و ر and the focus's enclosing-fort branch for ح ص ن. Render only as a whole-surah spatial analogy, not as a claim that the title is being explicitly etymologized in 24:23.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: `ٱلْمُحْصَنَاتِ` presents the targets through the image of enclosing protection.

activation_trace.role: A high surrounding wall supplies an outer textual perimeter.
Preservation within a fort supplies the inner personal perimeter.

changed_reading.before: The women alone are the fortified objects.
changed_reading.after: The surah can be imagined as building an outer wall of evidentiary and privacy rules around their inner fortification, so the accusation crosses both personal and textual perimeters.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because غ ف ل normally reads as unawareness here, while the packet's unmarked-place or unmarked-animal image is material. It remains anchored to the exact adjective and coheres with verbal casting at a fortified target. Downstream prose should mark it as an analogy for reputational marking, not replace the ordinary sense of innocent unawareness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places `ٱلْغَافِلَاتِ` between fortification and belief while speech is cast at the women.

activation_trace.role: A place or animal without a sign supplies the image of an unmarked social surface.
Verbal casting supplies the attempt to impose a public mark by speech.
The fort supplies the boundary that makes an unsupported imposed mark inadmissible.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the accusation attempts to brand an unmarked protected person with a social sign that her own conduct does not bear.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 24:39 explicitly images the deeds of disbelievers, not sexual accusations. It remains anchored through the focus branch of mis-aimed conjecture and the packet's mirage, thirst, reckoning, and failed-finding sequence. Render as an epistemic analogy for desire-shaped projection, not as direct identification of the two passages.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's ر م ي inventory includes casting a conjecture that does not hit correctly.

activation_trace.role: A conjecture that misses supplies the accusation's false projection.
A shining mirage that resembles water supplies a persuasive but absent object.
Thirst supplies the desire that biases perception toward the imagined object.
Conjectural reckoning supplies the mistaken identification before the later account.
Actual finding supplies the encounter in which the projected object disappears.

changed_reading.before: The accuser knowingly invents or repeats a false claim.
changed_reading.after: The accuser may also mistake a desire-shaped appearance for discovered fact, then cast that mirage at another person before reality is encountered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain model is surprising because weather in 24:43 is divine natural action, not culpable human speech. It remains anchored in the focus inventory's cloud-casting branch and in the context's exact sequence of cloud, joining, accumulation, rain, and impact. Render only as a material analogy for aggregation and delivery; do not equate divine weather with slander.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's ر م ي inventory contains a cloud that casts pieces or drops.

activation_trace.role: Cloud-like casting of pieces or drops supplies the focus anchor for distributed impacts.
The drawn cloud supplies the carrier medium.
Joining thing to thing supplies aggregation from separate fragments.
Layered accumulation supplies the growing mass.
Descending rain supplies multiplicity of released verbal drops.
Aimed impact on a target supplies the final strike.

changed_reading.before: Each accusation is a discrete projectile from one speaker.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, fragments can be joined and accumulated into a rumor-cloud that releases many small casts and eventually concentrates impact on a person.

strongest_changes: The repeated four-witness sequence turns verbal casting into a claim that rebounds when it cannot cross an evidence gate.
Group support, tongue reception, and spreading expand the plural throwers from originators to a relay network.
The command to pardon immediately before the passive curse separates divine consequence from permanent human ostracism.
The following bodily testimony makes the accuser's own tongue the counter-witness carried inside the offense.
Women's expressed will toward fortification later in the surah makes `المحصنات` agential rather than merely a status assigned from outside.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly converted one accusation into movement through gates and media: evidence, oath, tongue relay, communal selfhood, house threshold, bodily return, and, in contained outliers, mirage and accumulated weather.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether `يَرْمُونَ` in the focus includes knowing retransmitters or only the allegation's originators.
How strongly `ٱلْغَافِلَاتِ` marks innocent object-specific nonparticipation rather than a broader state of unawareness.
How directly the marital self-imprecation procedure in 24:6-9 controls the passive plural curse in 24:23.
How much of the spatial, mirage, and weather branch activation should enter downstream prose rather than remain diagnostic analogy.
